description: This file defines the DetailActivity class, which is an activity in an Android application responsible for displaying details about a tourist attraction. It includes methods for launching the activity with transition animations, creating intents, and initializing the UI with a fragment.

classes.name: DetailActivity
classes.description: An Android activity class that displays details about a tourist attraction, supporting shared element transitions.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: A static method to start this activity with optional transition animation if running on Lollipop or higher.

methods.name: getLaunchIntent
methods.description: Constructs an intent to launch DetailActivity with the specified attraction key.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds a fragment to display attraction details.
